fusions.name: Shed Shoal
fusions.desc: Flings 4 loose layers of scale in a fan, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Slide In
fusions.desc: Slides you up to 6 tiles across the ground to the target, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Silver Sheen
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% and your dodge chance by 15% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they spend at once and you gain a shield worth 5% of your maximum health per stack (26% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
